notes: Uses a real xdg-permission-store on the case bus with isolated XDG_DATA_HOME; gdbus provides independent public fixture setup and mutation observations. No FUSE or document portal is needed.
All service output and termination status are retained, including failed cases. Fixed catalogues and denominators are unchanged.

behaviors.preconditions: Installed fixture app, cache/config/data marker files and dynamic permissions across tables; unrelated app data and grants.
behaviors.expected: Normal uninstall preserves app data and grants; reinstall then --delete-data removes the app directory and every app grant, retains unrelated app data and grants, and removes the installed app.

behaviors.description: Create and replace permission strings through the CLI.
behaviors.preconditions: Real xdg-permission-store and gdbus; isolated case bus and data home.
behaviors.expected: Public Lookup and a later CLI query return exact supplied strings; another app's grant and existing data survive; a new table/object is created.

behaviors.description: Set typed GVariant data and reject malformed data.
behaviors.preconditions: Real permission store and gdbus with seeded string data.
behaviors.expected: Lookup returns the exact typed tuple replacing string data; omission preserves it; malformed data fails and leaves permissions and data unchanged.

behaviors.description: Enumerate all entries and select a table or object.
behaviors.preconditions: Two apps across three objects in two tables, including repeated object IDs.
behaviors.expected: Exact row sets for all, table-only, and table/object queries exclude unrelated entries.

behaviors.preconditions: Two apps across three objects in two tables.
behaviors.expected: Exact rows contain only the selected application's grants across both tables; absent app has no rows.

behaviors.description: Remove one application's grant from one object.
behaviors.preconditions: Two apps across three objects in two tables.
behaviors.expected: Lookup shows only the other app on the selected object; other objects and all data survive.

behaviors.preconditions: Two apps across three objects in two tables.
behaviors.expected: Public List no longer contains the object; both unrelated objects retain their exact grants and data.

behaviors.description: Reset an application's permissions across tables.
behaviors.preconditions: Two apps across three objects in two tables.
behaviors.expected: Every object loses the subject's grants, retains the control's grants and data, and CLI app queries agree.

behaviors.preconditions: Two apps across three objects in two tables.
behaviors.expected: App reset retains control grants; --all then empties permission maps on every object while retaining data and leaves no control-app query rows.

mappings.rationale: After a preserving plain-uninstall control, --delete-data removes the actual ~/.var/app directory and every seeded app grant across tables, while unrelated app files and permissions survive; CLI enumeration confirms uninstall.

surface_assertions.rationale: Dropping the flag preserves the marker directory and app permissions as demonstrated by the plain-uninstall control, failing both deletion checks.

mappings.rationale: Separate CLI query and public Lookup return exact replacement strings; also asserts creation of a new entry.
Public Lookup observes the typed tuple replacing initial string data and preserved on omission; invalid data leaves state intact.

surface_assertions.rationale: Ignoring --data leaves the seed string instead of the asserted uint32/string tuple.

mappings.rationale: Exact table/object result rows exclude the other object in that table and identically named object in another table; broader queries have distinct expected row sets.
Exact selected-app rows across both tables and an empty absent-app query assert dynamic permissions and app isolation.
Independent Lookup proves only the selected grant disappears, retaining another app plus unrelated objects and data.
Public List proves the entire selected object disappears and Lookup proves unrelated objects survive.
Independent Lookup on every seeded object proves all subject grants removed across tables, with control grants preserved; CLI app queries corroborate.
Option-only contrast of app-scoped and global resets.

surface_assertions.rationale: App reset leaves control grants; --all removes those remaining grants on every object, so dropping or app-scoping the option fails.
